The Dynamic Saunas Santorini DYN-6009-03 FS is a compact, 1–2 person Full Spectrum Near Zero EMF infrared sauna built for serious daily wellness. Whether you're unwinding after a long day or fitting a session in before work, the Santorini delivers Near, Mid, and Far infrared wavelengths in one efficient, easy-to-assemble cabin — right in your home.

Step inside and feel the difference that Full Spectrum infrared makes. Full spectrum means near and mid wavelengths on top of far. It runs to 118°F, plugs into a standard 120V outlet, and the panels are rated at 3 mG — ask any seller what distance that figure was measured at, including us. Near infrared generates surface warmth and supports skin tone and cellular rejuvenation. Together, all three wavelengths work simultaneously every session — something a single-spectrum sauna simply cannot offer.

The Santorini is built from natural reforested Canadian Hemlock wood, chosen for its hypoallergenic properties, tight grain, and excellent heat retention. Inside, 6 total PureTech™ heating elements — 4 Near Zero EMF FAR infrared carbon panels and 2 Near infrared elements — surround you with even, consistent heat. The Near Zero EMF rating (under 3 mG at 2 inches from panels) makes this one of the lowest-EMF full spectrum options in its size class. The ideal operating range is 118°F–132°F, with a maximum of 140°F, letting you dial in exactly the intensity your body needs.

Control your session effortlessly with the interior LED control panel, which adjusts temperature, time, and lighting in one place. An integrated Bluetooth stereo with built-in speaker lets you fill your session with music, podcasts, or guided meditations. The chromotherapy lighting system — updated with red light therapy in the 2024 refresh — adds a layer of mood and skin-supporting light therapy to every session. The clear tempered glass door keeps the cabin feeling open while retaining heat efficiently.

Setup takes two adults roughly 1–2 hours. The sauna arrives as a flat-pack kit with all hardware included, assembles on any flat indoor surface — including carpet — and plugs into a standard 120V 15-amp dedicated circuit. No hardwiring, no special electrical work required. Exterior dimensions of 39"W × 36"D × 75"H fit comfortably in a master bath, bedroom corner, basement, or walk-in closet.

Dynamic Saunas is a brand by Golden Designs, Inc., a manufacturer with over 15 years of infrared sauna design experience. The Dynamic line focuses on accessible, well-engineered infrared wellness — offering the latest heating technology, eco-conscious materials, and thoughtful features at a price point that makes daily home sauna use realistic for most households. Every Dynamic sauna is built for indoor residential use and backed by the Golden Designs manufacturer warranty.
